 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0010
 Shirley Rhodes, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
February 2, 2025
Plaintiff's counsel:
Nicole Arias, Mitchell & Hines Injury Lawyers
PARTIES
Plaintiff Shirley Rhodes is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision
described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to write motor vehicle policies in the State of Texas,
which issued the policy under which Plaintiff seeks coverage and benefits.
FACTS
On December 28, 2023, Plaintiff was driving through a signalized intersection in Houston when another vehicle entered the
intersection and struck the side of Plaintiff's vehicle. The impact drove Plaintiff's car sideways and caused the driver's side to
absorb the force of the collision. Plaintiff reported the collision to Defendant promptly, provided the information requested, and
has otherwise complied with the conditions of the policy. Defendant has not paid the benefits owed for Plaintiff's injuries and
losses within the time required by Texas law.
NEGLIGENCE
The at-fault driver failed to yield the right of way, failed to keep a proper lookout, and entered the intersection when it was unsafe
to do so, which is negligence under Texas law. Defendant is liable under the terms of its policy for benefits owed to its insured
and, to the extent applicable, is bound by the statutory duties of the Texas Insurance Code to attempt in good faith to effectuate a
prompt, fair, and equitable settlement of a claim once liability has become reasonably clear. Defendant failed to do so, and its
handling of the claim was unreasonable.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a serious knee injury requiring medical evaluation, treatment, and ongoing
care. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering, and will likely continue to incur future medical
costs and diminished capacity. Plaintiff seeks recovery of policy benefits, statutory interest, attorney's fees, and court costs, and
demands judgmnet against Defendant in the amount of $207,000.00, together with all other relief to which Plaintiff may be
entitled.
</page>
